messages:
maya: Heads-up — we have a quantization rollout to Dedicated tonight at 02:00 UTC. Need statuspage + customer email copy. @sophie can you start a draft?

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy queued: rollout/quant-v0.9 to dedicated-gpu-pool. Canary 5% in us-west1 at 02:00 UTC.

chris: Canary smoke passed on small seq tests. Metrics look OK. Manual watch for OOMs on 32k contexts.

leo: Note: we'll throttle batch sizes during first 30m to reduce risk. If latency > 300ms for >5% of p95 we'll hold and rollback.

sophie: Draft subject options:
- "Planned maintenance: Model optimization rollout (02:00 UTC)"
- "Planned runtime update affecting dedicated inference (Feb 14, 02:00 UTC)"

sophie: Statuspage snippet (short):
```
Starting 02:00 UTC we will deploy a quantized model variant to Dedicated GPU pools to improve cost and throughput. You may see brief latency variance; no planned downtime. We will revert if customer impact detected.
```

sophie: Statuspage snippet (detailed):
```
What we're doing: rolling out a quantized model variant to Dedicated capacity to reduce memory and improve throughput.
When: Feb 14, 02:00 — 03:00 UTC (rolling, no expected downtime)
Impact: Possible brief latency increases for a subset of requests; if we detect errors or higher error rates we'll pin to the previous variant and rollback.
Contact: support@redwood.ai
```

maya: Customer email draft (short):
Subject: Planned update to Dedicated inference (Feb 14)
Body:
Hi —
We will deploy an optimization to our Dedicated inference service on Feb 14 at 02:00 UTC. This is rolling and should not interrupt service. We may briefly revert for a small number of customers if we detect regressions. No action required on your side. — Redwood Support

chris: Ops note — for enterprise tenants with pinned versions, DO NOT force-unpin. We'll notify account teams for manual pin changes.

sophie: Who needs to be notified now? I propose: all active Dedicated customers, account teams for enterprise, and partners in EU region.

maya: Agreed. SRE will post to statuspage at 01:55 UTC, support will email at 01:50 UTC, account teams get a DM thread.

leo: Oncall will stand by. If rollback triggered we'll open an incident channel and set customer-facing status to "partial degradation".

chris: Copy-check: can we get sign-off on both status snippets and email? Once approved i'll flip feature flag for canary at 02:00.

maya: I approve. @chris you have green to start canary. @sophie send email at 01:50 UTC. :thumbsup:

sophie: Sending now to draft queue, tagging account teams. will post final to statuspage at 01:55.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: rollout/quant-v0.9 -> dedicated-gpu-pool. Canary traffic 5%.

maya: Thanks all — please ping this thread if anything changes.
